description: A creature with this ability can attempt to trip its opponent as a free action without provoking an attack of opportunity if it hits with the specified attack (usually bite or tail). If the trip attempt fails, the creature cannot be tripped in return.

name: Uncanny Dodge
description: The creature can react to danger before its senses would normally allow it to do so. It retains its Dexterity bonus to AC (if any) even if caught flat-footed or struck by an invisible attacker, losing this benefit only if immobilized.

name: Uncanny Dodge (Ex)
description: The creature can react to danger before its senses would normally allow it to do so. It retains its Dexterity bonus to AC (if any) even if caught flat-footed or struck by an invisible attacker, losing this benefit only if immobilized.

name: Undead Traits
description: Undead are immune to all mind-affecting effects, bleed, death effects, disease, paralysis, poison, sleep effects, stunning, ability drain, energy drain, nonlethal damage, fatigue, exhaustion, and physical ability damage (Str/Dex/Con). They have no Constitution score and are destroyed at 0 HP (or healed by negative energy).

name: Undead Traits (Ex)
description: Undead are immune to all mind-affecting effects, bleed, death effects, disease, paralysis, poison, sleep effects, stunning, ability drain, energy drain, nonlethal damage, fatigue, exhaustion, and physical ability damage (Str/Dex/Con). They have no Constitution score and are destroyed at 0 HP (or healed by negative energy).

name: Vermin Traits (Ex)
description: Vermin are mindless and possess immunity to all mind-affecting effects (charms, compulsions, morale effects, phantasms, patterns).

name: Versatile Performance
description: At 2nd level, a bard can substitute his bonus in a chosen Perform skill for the bonus in associated skills (e.g., Act for Bluff/Disguise, Oratory for Diplomacy/Sense Motive, Dance for Acrobatics/Fly).

name: Versatile Performance (Ex)
description: At 2nd level, a bard can substitute his bonus in a chosen Perform skill for the bonus in associated skills (e.g., Act for Bluff/Disguise, Oratory for Diplomacy/Sense Motive, Dance for Acrobatics/Fly).

name: Vulnerability (Ex)
description: A creature with a vulnerability takes half again as much (+50%) damage as normal from that energy type, regardless of whether a saving throw is allowed or successful.

name: Water Breathing
description: The creature breathes water freely and cannot drown in water.

name: Water Breathing (Ex)
description: The creature breathes water freely and cannot drown in water.

name: Weapon Mastery
description: At 20th level, a fighter chooses one weapon. Any attacks made with that weapon automatically confirm critical threats, and its critical multiplier is increased by 1 (e.g., x2 becomes x3). In addition, he cannot be disarmed while wielding it.

name: Weapon Mastery (Ex)
description: At 20th level, a fighter chooses one weapon. Any attacks made with that weapon automatically confirm critical threats, and its critical multiplier is increased by 1 (e.g., x2 becomes x3). In addition, he cannot be disarmed while wielding it.

name: Weapon Training
description: Starting at 5th level, a fighter selects a weapon group. He gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with weapons in that group. Every 4 levels thereafter, he selects another weapon group and increases existing bonuses by +1 (+4 max at 17th level).

name: Weapon Training (Ex)
description: Starting at 5th level, a fighter selects a weapon group. He gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with weapons in that group. Every 4 levels thereafter, he selects another weapon group and increases existing bonuses by +1 (+4 max at 17th level).

name: Web
description: Creatures with the web ability can shoot webs up to 8 times per day (or create stationary sheets). Victims struck are entangled and anchored to the spot. Escaping requires an Escape Artist check or Combat Maneuver check (DC 10 + 1/2 HD + Con mod). Webs have HP based on creature HD and take double damage from fire.

name: Web (Ex)
description: Creatures with the web ability can shoot webs up to 8 times per day (or create stationary sheets). Victims struck are entangled and anchored to the spot. Escaping requires an Escape Artist check or Combat Maneuver check (DC 10 + 1/2 HD + Con mod). Webs have HP based on creature HD and take double damage from fire.

name: Well-Versed
description: At 2nd level, a bard gains a +4 bonus on saving throws made against bardic performance, sonic, and language-dependent effects.

name: Well-Versed (Ex)
description: At 2nd level, a bard gains a +4 bonus on saving throws made against bardic performance, sonic, and language-dependent effects.

name: Whirlwind
description: The creature can transform itself into a whirlwind as a standard action. It can engulf creatures of up to its size, dealing automatic slam damage and lifting them into the air on a failed Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 HD + Str mod).

name: Whirlwind (Su)
description: The creature can transform itself into a whirlwind as a standard action. It can engulf creatures of up to its size, dealing automatic slam damage and lifting them into the air on a failed Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 HD + Str mod).

name: Wild Empathy (Ex)
description: A druid or ranger can improve the initial attitude of an animal. This ability functions just like a Diplomacy check made to improve the attitude of a person, adding class level + Charisma modifier.

name: Wild Shape
description: At 4th level, a druid gains the ability to turn herself into any Small or Medium animal and back again once per day (as beast shape I). As she gains levels, she can transform into Diminutive, Huge, elemental, or plant creatures for 1 hour per druid level.

name: Wild Shape (Su)
description: At 4th level, a druid gains the ability to turn herself into any Small or Medium animal and back again once per day (as beast shape I). As she gains levels, she can transform into Diminutive, Huge, elemental, or plant creatures for 1 hour per druid level.
